config.threshold_rule: min r with sum(sigma[r:]^2) <= tau; common tau; exact budget
config.adaptive_semantics: recompute fixed-basis tail energy on propagated calibration values; bases frozen
config.forward_evaluation_semantics: objective plus explicit adaptive calibration forwards; common instance setup excluded
config.memory_proxy_semantics: compressed-coordinate parameters plus peak batched activations; analytical, not measured RSS/VRAM

limitations: five exact-oracle seeds per size in a synthetic heterogeneous D=16 chain
projector bases are frozen so the exact terminal oracle remains valid
memory is an analytical compressed-coordinate proxy, not measured RSS or VRAM
wall time is single-run CPU timing and is not a robust hardware benchmark
